four_box.note: Screener.in: FY25 rev Rs2,529cr +5%, PAT +28% to Rs322cr, 2nd-largest India container-glass player -- steady glass-packaging demand shift but not exponential = tailwind weak; already Rs5,203cr mcap, 2nd-largest by capacity = size math limits a 10x from here = tam no; capital-intensity + logistics + closures-tech relationships give some edge but customers can multi-source = moat weak; P/E 14.1x on ROCE ~20-26% and 28% PAT growth is undemanding = valuation yes, the exception preserving existing 10x-in-2-3-years at Low-Medium conviction.
